summary: Iteration 3 backend testing complete: 16/16 pytest tests PASSED. Verified (a) CMS idempotent seed + new sections (library_banner, free_resources, expanded hero) editable via admin PUT, (b) /api/pdf/resources/subscribers returns full structured payload with no _id leak, (d) Mailgun resource email gateway works end-to-end with proper validation (422 invalid email, 400 unknown resource) and graceful sandbox-failure handling. All regressions (progress, .docx downloads, /platforms, admin login, sitemap XML) pass.
critical_code_review_comments: pdf_routes.py: GET /api/pdf/resources/subscribers has NO admin-auth gate (comment in code: 'no auth for now — add later'). This leaks every subscriber email publicly. Recommend adding the same Bearer-token check as the cms_routes admin endpoints before going live.

seed_content endpoint: catches Exception and returns {error: ...} with HTTP 200 instead of raising HTTPException(500). Silent failure mode — admin sees 'success' even on DB error. Consider raising 500.

email_service.send_resource_email: Mailgun call uses `requests` (sync) inside an async FastAPI route, blocking the event loop for up to 30s on slow networks. Wrap in run_in_threadpool or switch to httpx.AsyncClient.
pdf_routes.py is now 750+ lines mixing PDF generation, .docx serving, premium-pack flow, email gateway, and analytics — consider splitting into resources_routes.py + premium_routes.py.
/api/content response shape is {success, content:{...}} (nested) while many CMS-style endpoints return the section dict directly. Document this in the API contract so the frontend doesn't break.
seed_data_creation: Created subscriber records for testuser1@example.com (rule-of-72, opted-in) and testuser2@example.com (budget-503020) via /api/pdf/resources/request-download.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 verified Mailgun integration with sandbox domain — testuser2 returned email_delivery='failed' (expected: sandbox can only send to authorized recipients). For real-recipient verification, override MAILGUN_DOMAIN/SENDER or whitelist the test email in Mailgun. CMS new sections live: library_banner + free_resources. Hero section now has badge/headline_line1/headline_line2/subtitle_line1/subtitle_line2 in addition to legacy title/subtitle/cta_text. /api/content returns {success, content:{section_id:{...}}}.
